honesty_notes: 10,000 model configurations = 20 base types × 500 variations each. NOT 10,000 unique AI models.
Each cycle tests 500 sampled models, extrapolated to 10,000. Sampling for performance.
All predictions are SIMULATED. Precision is NOT benchmarked. No guaranteed accuracy.
Oracle auto-generates test results, NOT live trading alpha.
Model 'accuracy' is simulated backtest correctness (55% baseline), NOT real prediction accuracy.

20 unique AI model types: 10 original (Trend, MeanRev, Volatility, Momentum, Sentiment, Quantum, Fractal, Correlation, Kernel, Neural) + 10 new (Transformer, RL, GAN, Bayesian, Diffusion, GraphNN, AttentionLSTM, Autoencoder, Wavelet, Fuzzy).
